name: SEO Audit & Analyzer by GGR
author: Yogesh Kumar Raghav

sections.description:
SEO Audit & Analyzer by GGR helps you improve on-page SEO, content quality, readability, and conversion optimization directly inside WordPress.

Unlike traditional SEO tools that only analyze live URLs, GGR can audit draft, private, and published content before it goes live, helping you fix issues earlier in the publishing process.

The GGR SEO Command Center provides a site-wide dashboard that combines SEO audits, content analysis, conversion insights, schema monitoring, and actionable recommendations in one place, alongside real-time scoring and optimization tools inside the post editor.

Built for content creators, bloggers, businesses, WooCommerce stores, and agencies who want practical SEO insights without relying on external services or complex workflows.

SEO Command Center (Dashboard)

  • Overall SEO health score for your whole site
  • Issues by severity — missing meta descriptions, missing focus keywords, duplicate titles, thin content, missing internal links, images missing alt text, and more
  • SEO content performance table across posts, pages, and products with per-item grades
  • Readability breakdown (Flesch score, passive voice, long sentences, transition words, paragraph length, subheading use)
  • Prioritized SEO growth opportunities with estimated score impact
  • Schema status tracker (Article, Product, LocalBusiness, FAQ, HowTo, Review, BreadcrumbList, Sitelinks)
  • 404 monitor for deleted/trashed content and redirections
  • Sitemap & social tracker (indexed posts/pages/images, Open Graph and Twitter Card coverage)

Page Analyzer (Pro)

  • Search any post, page, or product by title, slug, URL, category, tag, or custom field
  • Full SEO breakdown per page: title, meta, content, readability, links, and schema
  • Focus keyword analysis, readability score, schema detection
  • Image ALT audit, internal link check, and OG/social tag validation

Content Analyzer

  • Site-wide content quality audit across all public post types
  • Word count and Flesch readability score for every page
  • Content grade and word count distribution charts
  • Flags thin content, missing H2s, missing ALT text, missing internal links, and keyword stuffing

Conversion Audit

  • Site-wide conversion-readiness audit for every page
  • Conversion score and grade per page, with CTA and trust-signal detection
  • CTA type breakdown (Buy Now, Get Started, Contact Us, Learn More, Download, Subscribe, Book a Call)
  • Flags pages with no CTA, no trust signals, no form, or weak above-the-fold content
  • WooCommerce product health checks (missing description, image, price, or short description)

In the post editor

  • Live SEO score with potential-gain indicator as you write
  • SEO Foundation checklist (focus keyword usage, meta title/description, featured image, category)
  • SEO snippet editor with live Google-style preview
  • Content analysis (word count, keyword occurrences, keyword density)
  • Link analysis (internal/external link counts)
  • Media SEO (featured image, image count, missing ALT tags)
  • Content structure breakdown (H1/H2/H3 counts)
  • Admin bar SEO score indicator with instant rescan, showing post type and status (Draft, Published, Private)

What the plugin checks

  • Title tag presence
  • Meta description detection
  • Heading hierarchy (H1 – H4)
  • Content length and readability indicators
  • Internal and external links
  • Image ALT attributes
  • Canonical tag presence
  • Noindex detection
  • Structured data (JSON-LD) and schema type coverage
  • Calls-to-action, trust signals, and form presence (Conversion Audit)
  • WooCommerce product data completeness
  • Basic technical SEO signals (sitemap, social tags, 404s)

Features

  • Site-wide SEO Command Center dashboard
  • Per-page deep analysis with Page Analyzer (Pro)
  • Site-wide Content Analyzer with grading and distribution charts
  • Site-wide Conversion Audit with CTA and trust-signal detection
  • Visual SEO health score with breakdown
  • Clear issue categories: Good, Needs Improvement, Critical
  • Actionable, prioritized recommendations with estimated score impact
  • Admin bar SEO score indicator on edit screens with instant rescan
  • Per-page score tracking (saved for each post/page/product)
  • Automatic setup screen after plugin activation
  • AJAX-powered fast audit processing
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • No tracking or third-party analytics services
  • Audit draft and private posts before publishing
  • No dependency on live URLs (content-based analysis)
  • Works with all public post types (including custom post types) and WooCommerce products
  • Smart permalink warnings for SEO best practices
  • Simple enable/disable toggle in Settings
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ggr-website-audit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. After activation, you will be redirected to the setup screen.
  4. Visit GGR Website Audit → Dashboard and click Run Full Audit to generate your first site-wide report.
  5. Open any post or page to see its live SEO score and checklist in the editor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin guarantee SEO rankings?

No. The plugin provides analysis of on-page SEO, content, and conversion signals. Rankings depend on many factors like content quality, backlinks, and competition.

Does the plugin send data externally?

No. All analysis runs locally inside your WordPress installation. No external API calls or tracking are used.

What’s the difference between the free and Pro versions?

The free version includes the SEO Command Center dashboard, Content Analyzer, Conversion Audit, and full post-editor integration. Page Analyzer’s deep per-page search and analysis tool is a Pro feature.

Can I audit any website?

The plugin is intended primarily for analyzing pages within your own WordPress site.

Does the plugin modify themes or styles?

No. It does not modify theme files or override global styles.

Does this plugin store cookies?

A temporary cookie may be used to prevent repeated scans in a short time. No personal data is stored.
